name: Pressure Differential Transmitter
note: The D is a variable modifier applied right after the first letter, not a separate function — same pattern as TDT (Temperature Differential Transmitter) or FDT.

name: Pressure Switch High-High
note: A doubled modifier (HH, LL) marks a second, more severe alarm/trip threshold above the first — e.g. PSH warns, PSHH trips.

name: Pressure Safety Valve
note: S here is the "Safety" modifier, not "Switch" — context (a valve, not an electrical contact) disambiguates it; this is the mechanical relief valve, not an instrument loop.

name: Flow Ratio Recording Controller
note: F as a succeeding letter (ratio) plus F as the first letter (flow) — the two F's mean different things depending on position.

name: Flow Element
note: The primary sensing element itself (e.g. an orifice plate) — distinct from FT, the transmitter reading it.

name: Level Gauge
note: G here is "Glass, Gauge, Viewing Device" — a local sight glass, not a transmitted signal at all.

name: Temperature Element
note: The sensor itself (e.g. an RTD or thermocouple) — distinct from TT, the transmitter.

name: Temperature Recording Controller
note: The first succeeding letter (R, passive/readout) records for a human operator; the second (C, active/output) is the automated control action — this passive-then-active letter order is a general ISA-5.1 convention, not specific to temperature.

name: Analytical Indicating Transmitter
note: A covers any analysis not given its own letter — the specific analysis (O2, pH, conductivity...) is defined outside the tag bubble, in the instrument index or P&ID note.

name: Position Indicator
note: Commonly a valve limit-switch or damper position indication.

name: Position Switch, valve confirmed Open
note: A common project-level extension: O/C suffixes for open/closed confirmation aren't in the base ISA table itself, but are near-universal practice.

name: Hand Switch
note: An operator pushbutton or selector switch — H as first letter means "Hand" (manually initiated), not a measured process variable at all.

name: Hand Indicating Controller
note: A manual loader/setpoint station — the operator directly sets the output, there's no automatic control action.

name: Relay/Compute, Switch function
note: Y is reserved for a function that doesn't fit the standard measured-variable categories — commonly a relay, solenoid, or logic/compute block.
